corrections.value: Salman Azhar holds Duke MS and PhD degrees in computer science (James B. Duke Fellow) and a BS from Wake Forest. He co-founded more than 30 startups in predictive computing, business intelligence and data analytics. In May 2018 he became Managing Director of the Duke Angel Network (later Duke Capital Partners). Today he is a General Partner of Azimuth Opportunity Fund, which buys pre-IPO shares of unicorns from early investors, and Executive in Residence at Fuqua. He has invested in more than 200 startups over 25 years.

His current vehicle (Azimuth) does late-stage pre-IPO secondaries ('specializes in buying shares of pre-IPO unicorns from early investors'), and his seed angel activity is only claimed in aggregate on investor-profile pages, with no dated 2025-2026 seed checks. His AI/NLP and financial-systems background and Duke ties are real positives for a personal angel ask. https://emergingmanagerspodcast.com/focusing-on-pre-exit-secondary-markets-with-salman-azhar-of-azimuth-opportunity-fund/ (search snippet)

corrections.value: Medium

reviews.notes: The Duke MS/PhD in CS (PhD 1994) is solid, and the 2026 role is confirmed by a January 2026 podcast. The weak point is criterion 3: his fund is pre-IPO secondaries, and his seed angel activity is evidenced only by aggregate profile claims (Wellfound/PitchBook). I kept him included, but the pitch must target his personal angel check, and fit was lowered to Low on stage. Search results also showed RocketReach, ContactOut and whitebridge contact pages; per the rules these were ignored and not cited. A Duke CS course document (courses.cs.duke.edu/.../azhar.pdf) describing Azimuth also appeared but was not used. Email remains not found.
